question: Rajkumar Singhjit Singh was awarded the Padma Shri in 1986 for his contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

• **Rajkumar Singhjit Singh **is a leading exponent, choreographer and a guru of Indian classical dance form of Manipuri.
 
• He was awarded with the** sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1984.**
